First version. ; ;- function red_pinhole_pitch_arcsec, isodate ;; The pinhole array installed just before the 2023 season. ;; Calculated in 2024 from the pitch of the old array and the ratio ;; of pitches in pixels of the old and new array. if isodate gt 2023-01-01 then return, 4.13 ; ["] ;; The pinhole array used 2004-2012. Based on calibration with ;; SDO/HMI images in 2013, data from 2012. return, 5.12 ; ["] end
